Assistance & Policies

Contact & partnership FAQ.

What is the typical response turnaround for inquiries?

A response timeframe has not yet been published. Submit the relevant form so the connected care workflow can acknowledge and route the request once configured.

What are the wholesale minimum order quantities (MOQ)?

Wholesale quantities and commercial terms require client confirmation. Use the wholesale form to share your expected volume and product interests without assuming a published minimum.

Can I schedule an in-person store visit?

No verified store address or public visiting schedule is currently available. Confirmed location information can be published here when the client supplies it.

How can I request certificates of analysis (COAs) for specific batches?

Select "Certificate of Analysis Request" under the general inquiry form, and include the lot number stamped on the base of your packaging or carton.
